reviews.text: Typical Petsmart has all of your essential food / toys, and basic husbandry supplies. Went shopping for fish and purchased some neon tetras. Few days later they had ich. Went back to purchase ich-cure, and decided to look around at their tanks. They had cichlids actively dying from ich, suffering and suffocating at the bottom of their tanks. Knowing that their filtration systems are all interconnected, and that they use the same 1-2 nets dipping into tanks, it’s no wonder my fish got it as well. Luckily, I caught it very early and treated promptly. But having sick fish on the sales floor is not a good look what so ever. As a consumer, I should have investigated all of their tanks more thoroughly prior to purchasing fish. But on the other side of that coin, you (should)  have some confidence that the establishment you are purchasing from minimally cares for their product.  Will stick to purchasing our fish from specialty stores, where the employees care about what they’re selling.

I’ll start by saying I am a military family so for 12 years I’ve had experiences with hundreds of different Grooming locations with the same dog. We were in town visiting family when I decided to get my dog groomed. My mistake that I didn’t realize that I went to PetSmart not Petco.

For 12 years, I say the exact same haircut and show the exact same photograph for my dog. The groomer at this location said that she had 20 years experience, but she could not understand what I was asking for even when I showed a photograph. They told me that they can only do a half an inch cut, which is fine, but anything lower would be a surcharge. She stressed this several times so I kept saying that’s fine but when I got my dog back I measured her hair and it was 1 inch. She didn’t do anything I asked for and honestly, it was the worst haircut she’s gotten in 12 years. It was uneven, her hair look like she basically just got a wash. Her hair was even pointing forward into her eyes. I had to cut several spots on my own just to make it look better and for her to actually be able to see.

This was just my experience with one of the groomers, but for them to stress so hard about getting charged more for anything larger than a half an inch cut when Petco will go for a fourth an inch cut no problem. The worst part is PetSmart didn’t even give me the size that I wanted and my dog had to get another haircut immediately after.

I almost never comment about what employees are doing at their place of work, but I did comment about the two girls standing there with a line of four or five people that I had been standing in for eight minutes, one of the girls who was having her very social conversation looked at me and said “Well, if she’s not gonna ask for help I’m not helping.” If you are in a hurry, this is not a location I would recommend going to.
